**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement meets the **preferred** MINCOMMIT position — there is no minimum purchase commitment on Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 (p0052)** — Charges are tied to Services specified in Order Forms/Service Option Attachments and may be one-time, installment, recurring or usage-based. Fees are for ordered or actual usage only; no floor, no take-or-pay, no shortfall mechanic.
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142)** — the only "volume" reference in the document; it leaves capacity sizing and any additional-capacity requests to Customer's determination rather than committing us to volumes.
- **§ 14.11 No Resale (p0190)** — a scope restriction, not a purchase commitment.
- **§ 3.4 (p0044–p0046)** — a convenience exit at one month's notice backstops anything a future Order Form might contain.

Searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay", "shortfall" and "purchase" surfaced no commitment language.

**Residual noted, not flagged:** § 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A." That hook is dormant in the Base Terms, but when Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments are issued we should confirm any such charge is a true-up of unrecovered set-up//amortized cost rather than a penalty for unbought volume — otherwise a commitment could re-enter through the attachment layer.
